Message: PDF version 1.7 supports standard accessibility features.
Remediation: Ensure the PDF is created with compliant PDF 1.7 or 2.0 specifications without syntax corruption.

Message: Document is not encrypted; accessibility content extraction is unrestricted.
Remediation: Ensure the PDF is created with compliant PDF 1.7 or 2.0 specifications without syntax corruption.

Message: Font 'Helvetica' is not embedded.
Evidence: Font: Helvetica, Subtype: Type1, Used on page(s): [1]
Remediation: Open document in Acrobat Pro Preflight, select 'Embed missing fonts', and save the file.

Message: Font 'Helvetica' lacks an explicit /ToUnicode mapping stream.
Remediation: Convert font to OpenType/TrueType with explicit Unicode mappings before exporting to PDF.

Message: No unannounced Unicode Private Use Area (PUA) glyphs detected.
Remediation: Replace custom icon/symbol font glyphs with standard Unicode symbols or enclose in a Span with /ActualText.

Message: No replacement characters (U+FFFD) detected in extracted text.
Remediation: Ensure font embedding and ToUnicode CMaps map every glyph to a real character.

Message: Document is NOT a Tagged PDF. Assistive technologies cannot determine reading order or semantics.
Remediation: Tag the document using an accessible PDF authoring tool or Adobe Acrobat Pro's 'Autotag Document' feature.

Message: No interactive annotations found in document.
Remediation: Tag untagged annotations or link them using an OBJR (Object Reference) in Acrobat Pro.

Message: No non-conforming embedded files detected in the document.
Remediation: Ensure attached files are in accessible formats or provide an accessible alternative description.

Message: Document primary natural language is not specified.
Remediation: Set the document primary language in Document Properties (e.g., 'en-US', 'en', 'es').

Message: No StructTreeRoot exists in the document.
Remediation: Add structural tags to the document using an accessible PDF creator or Acrobat Pro.

Message: No lists detected in document (or document contains no list structures).
Remediation: In Acrobat Pro Tags panel, re-nest list elements so that L contains LI, and LI contains Lbl and LBody.

Message: No tables detected in document.
Remediation: Identify column or row headers in Acrobat Pro Table Editor, set cell type to Header Cell, and define Scope.

Message: Cannot verify figure alternate descriptions because document is untagged.
Remediation: In Acrobat Pro, right-click Figure tag > Properties > Tag tab > Alternative Text, and enter a descriptive alternative.

Message: No XMP metadata stream found in the PDF catalog dictionary.
Remediation: Add standard XMP metadata to the document.

Message: Document Title is missing from metadata.
Remediation: Provide a concise, descriptive document Title in File > Properties > Title.

Message: PDF/UA identification flag (pdfuaid:part=1) is missing from XMP metadata.
Remediation: Add PDF/UA identifier using Acrobat Preflight or your PDF/UA export setting.

Message: DisplayDocTitle is not set to true. The window title bar will show the filename instead of the document title.
Remediation: Set Initial View > Show > Document Title in File Properties.

Message: Page tab navigation conforms to document structure order.
Evidence: Tab order is set to Structure (/Tabs /S) across pages.
Remediation: In Acrobat Pro, open File > Properties > Initial View, and under 'Window Options' set 'Show' to 'Document Title' instead of 'File Name'.

Message: Image on page 1 does not have alternative text.
Remediation: Add alternative text or mark image as decorative artifact.

Message: No time-based multimedia or audio/video streams detected.
Remediation: Provide synchronized captions or text transcripts for embedded media.

Message: Untagged document fails Info and Relationships (SC 1.3.1). Structure is lost.
Remediation: Tag the document to convey relationships to assistive technologies.

Message: Verify color contrast (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text) and ensure color is not the only means of conveying information.
Evidence: Color contrast requires visual sampling or human verification.
Remediation: Verify visual contrast of text against background meets 4.5:1 for regular text and 3:1 for large text.

Message: Keyboard focus and tab order conform to logical document structure.
Remediation: Ensure page tab navigation follows document structure order.

Message: No timed transitions, automated page flips, or timeouts detected.
Remediation: Do not set automated timeouts or slide transitions without user pause controls.

Message: No flashing or rapid animated content detected in the document.
Remediation: Avoid animations or blinking content that flashes more than three times in any one-second period.

Message: Document lacks a descriptive Title (WCAG SC 2.4.2 Page Titled).
Evidence: Title property is missing or empty.
Remediation: Add a descriptive title in File Properties.

Message: Ambiguous link text 'click here' on page 1 does not convey purpose out of context (SC 2.4.4).
Remediation: Make link text descriptive of its target destination (e.g. 'Read the 2026 Financial Report').

Message: No input modality conflicts detected with touch or pointer gestures.
Remediation: Ensure visible text labels match accessible names.

Message: Primary language of the document is not specified (WCAG SC 3.1.1).
Remediation: Set the primary language in Document Properties.

Message: Interactive fields and links operate predictably without unexpected context changes.
Evidence: Action triggers conform to standard behavior.
Remediation: Avoid automated submit actions or context jumps when form fields receive focus.

Message: No interactive form fields found in document.
Remediation: Provide clear tooltips (/TU) or accessible labels for all interactive form fields.

Message: Assistive technology compatibility is compromised by untagged structure or restricted extraction permissions.
Remediation: Enable accessibility extraction and tag the document.

Message: No data tables found in document.
Remediation: Ensure table cells align evenly and provide descriptive column and row headers.

Message: Ambiguous link label 'click here' on page 1 provides insufficient context out of context.
Remediation: Change the link label to describe the specific destination or topic (e.g., 'Download Annual Report 2026').

Message: No figures present requiring AI semantic evaluation.
Remediation: Write concise, descriptive alt text that explains what the image illustrates without saying 'image of' or 'graphic of'.

Message: Flesch Reading Ease score: 34.8/100 (Difficult / Academic). Avg sentence length: 8.0 words.
Remediation: Simplify sentence structures and reduce jargon where possible for broad audience comprehension.

Message: Document structural outline and navigation elements are well-proportioned.
Remediation: Synchronize document bookmarks with the heading hierarchy.
